Also, pour alcohol on the razor before and after or use a new razor. I don't actually wax - I shave - and I get painful cyst-like growths by the groin. I dislike pubic hair, so I shave it, but I have to be careful because it's an area on the body that isn't necessarily considered clean. Make sure your razor is sharp. I recommend at least 3 blades minimum.

OH one more thing: soak the area with hot water first. Afterwards, put cold water over it. The hot water helps to open the pores and reduces the chance of irritating the hair follicles. The cold water helps to tighten the skin and close pores so dirt and germs and sweat are more likely not to get in and cause blemishes/infections.
